## What happened?

A clear, concise description of the bug.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Go to '...'
2. Type '...'
3. See error / wrong behavior

## What I expected

A clear description of what you expected to happen.

## What actually happened

A clear description of what actually happened. Include screenshots if applicable.

## Environment

- **Lens version**: (e.g., v0.1.4 — check chrome://extensions)
- **Chrome version**: (e.g., 138.0.7204.100)
- **Operating system**: (e.g., macOS 14.5, Windows 11, Ubuntu 24.04)
- **AI provider where the bug appeared**: (e.g., chatgpt.com, claude.ai, gemini.google.com)
- **Was Lens detecting a specific PII type when the bug happened?**: (e.g., "was trying to paste an SSN")

## Privacy note

Lens is privacy-first: NO prompt content ever leaves your browser. We don't need (and don't want) to see what you were typing. Just describe the **structure** of the issue (which provider, what kind of detection, what happened), not the actual content.

## Severity

- [ ] This is a critical security issue (please also email security@aegisgatesecurity.io)
- [ ] This makes Lens unusable on a specific provider
- [ ] This is a false positive (Lens warned me but shouldn't have)
- [ ] This is a false negative (Lens should have warned me but didn't)
- [ ] This is a UI/UX issue (banner appearance, popup, etc.)
- [ ] Other (please describe)

## Possible fix

If you have ideas about what the fix should look like, share them here.
